pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify Customer Context Before Claiming Prior Details
lesson.when: A customer mentions following up on a previous inquiry but prior transcript or system evidence for specific details is missing
lesson.do: Acknowledge the follow-up generally and ask the customer to clarify their specific question or product of interest
lesson.otherwise: State specific prior details or product SKUs without verified evidence
